name: proto-include-root-directory-holds-a-schema-file
description: With no buf.yaml and no proto.import_paths, the import roots are buf's for a directory with no buf.yaml, the target root, besides the include roots of upstream copies: a schema file directly in the include root's directory makes that directory no root, so an import of a file below it by its path from there still resolves under no root, and the importer publishes nothing and carries an unresolved-import note. Since a schema file that could not be read may use any declaration, every record of the target is published live, and a schema-findings-withheld note names the target root.
